REINFORCED CONCRETE - MINIMUM CEMENT CONTENT
| Moderate - for example, sheltered from heavy and wind driven rain and against freezing, whilst saturated with water; buried concrete in soil and concrete continuously under water. | 250 | 0.6 | 290 | 0.55 |

REINFORCED CONCRETE - MAXIMUM WATER CEMENT RATIO
| Moderate - for example, sheltered from heavy and wind driven rain and against freezing, whilst saturated with water; buried concrete in soil and concrete continuously under water. | 250 | 0.6 | 290 | 0.55 |
A. Cement shall be ordinary Portland cement conforming to IS 269 for all purpose unless specified differently.
The PH value of water shall not be less than 6 and more than 9.

|                    | Permissible Limit, Maximum                                                   |
| Sulphates (as SO4) | 500 mg/l                                                                     |

|                    | Permissible Limit, Maximum                                                   |
| Chlorides (as C1)  | 2000 mg/l for plain concrete work and 1000 mg/l for reinforced concrete work |

|                    | Permissible Limit, Maximum                                                   |
| Suspended matter   | 2000 mg/l                                                                    |
